sections.heading: Carried by more than one source

items.title: Deno is joining Cloudflare
items.blurb: The Deno team is joining Cloudflare to radically simplify self-hosting Workers and Durable Objects, so developers can use the same primitives in more places.

items.title: I Found a $90k Remote Code Execution Vulnerability in Google
AI in Production: Panellists Highlight Silent Failures, Harness Engineering, and Agent Governance
items.blurb: A recent InfoQ webinar examined operational challenges in deploying agentic systems. Key points included issues like semantic and embedding drift, which can lead to significant errors.

items.title: Presentation: Exploding GPUs
items.blurb: Andrew Martin discusses why AI security is fundamentally tied to Kubernetes security.

items.title: Chainguard Launches Secure Workspaces and Checks for AI Coding Agents
items.blurb: Software supply chain security company Chainguard has announced two beta products for running and testing code written by developers and AI agents.

items.title: Article: Server-Side DPoP and Token Exchange in Spring Security 7
items.blurb: Spring Authorization Server now lives inside Spring Security 7 under the same Maven coordinates, so the upgrade is a version bump.
